correctness.rationale: Unit-sphere dot-product geometry rigorously gives q(theta)=sin(theta/2)-(1-cos(theta/2))/2. Uniform cosine integration yields E[q]=1/2, E[q^2]=(pi-1)/8. A stand-alone finite checker tested coefficient arithmetic, overlap multiplicities, numerical integral and point-sampling diagnostics.
